stories.title: US Navy to stay in Persian Gulf as long as necessary, energy secretary says
stories.summary: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright expressed confidence in this
article_sentences: US Navy personnel will remain in the Persian Gulf for as long as necessary, Secretary of Energy Chris Wright said.
"I’m confident they will," he told CNBC in response to a question on the matter.
The United States and Israel launched a war against Iran on February 28.
In June, Washington and Tehran signed a memorandum of understanding envisaging an immediate ceasefire on all fronts, including Lebanon.
However, early on July 8, the United States resumed massive airstrikes on Iran, accusing Tehran of violating their previous agreements, particularly regarding the Strait of Hormuz.
On August 24, US Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent announced that Washington would dramatically tighten its unilateral sanctions on Iran, seeking to block Tehran’s sources of revenue.

stories.title: Participation of investors from friendly countries in IPOs remains limited — VTB
stories.summary: Russian institutional and retail investors are the primary participants in offerings on the equity market at present
article_sentences: The participation of investors from friendly countries in Russian IPOs remains limited, Vitaly Sergeychuk, Deputy President, Chairman of the Management Board of VTB Bank, said in an interview with TASS on the sidelines of the Eastern Economic Forum (EEF).
"Investors from friendly countries are present, though their participation in IPOs remains limited for now," he said.
Russian institutional and retail investors are still the primary participants in offerings on the equity market now, Sergeychuk added.
The Eastern Economic Forum is taking place on September 1-4 in Vladivostok on the campus of the Far Eastern Federal University.
The main theme of this year’s EEF is "The Far East: Development for the Benefit of People." The event is organized by the Roscongress Foundation with the support of the Russian government.
TASS is its general information partner.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a phenomenon – but there is much more to the gaming world
stories.summary: As Rockstar’s blockbuster prepares to dominate the headlines, it’s time for the mainstream media to stop treating video games as a novelty that needs explaining Predictably, the Grand Theft Auto VI “extended look” which premiered on Netflix last week was a success for all involved. The 30-minute preview scorched to No 1 on the viewing chart and even brought the site down for a few minutes as millions of gamers tried to watch what was, effectively, a very long teaser trailer.
